title: 第14章智降守兽，拜见守关人
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还

第14章智降守兽，拜见守关人

    青铜殿内的空气干燥得像存放了数千年的墓穴。

    苏余站在传送阵落点，背心渗出的冷汗被殿内不知来处的阴风吹得冰凉。

    三百息时间燃烧的后遗症还在——四肢百骸像是被人抽走了骨头又塞回去，每走一步都听见关节在发出干涩的摩擦声。

    他环顾四周。

    大殿高数十丈，穹顶上刻满了密密麻麻的星图，星光沿着刻痕缓慢流转，像是某种早已失传的计时之法。

    殿壁是整块的青铜浇筑，青铜表面覆盖着一层墨绿色的铜锈，铜锈之下隐约可见浮雕的轮廓——那是一幅幅战争场景，有人在对天挥剑，有人在火焰中化为灰烬。

    所有的浮雕人物都只有同一个表情：仰面向天，怒目圆睁。

    苏余知道这些浮雕刻的是什么。

    苏玄恶念的记忆碎片里有同样的画面——时族覆灭。

    他没有过多停留。

    殿中央有一条笔直的甬道，通向第二重门。

    甬道两侧立着十二尊青铜人像，每一尊都有三丈高，手持长戈，戈尖低垂交叉在甬道上方，形成一道寒光凛冽的刀锋走廊。

    人像的面部被人故意凿平了，只剩下一片平滑的斜面，像十二面模糊的镜子。

    苏余穿行其间。

    脚步声在青铜甬道里弹跳回荡，从一声变成两声，从两声变成无数声。

    他没有停，也没有回头。

    在矿洞里待了三年的人，早就学会了和黑暗中的回声共处。

    甬道尽头是第二重门，门高九丈，通体青铜，门上刻着一行时族祖篆。

    “时王碑持有者，方可入此门。”

    苏余将手背上的“时”字篆文按在青铜门上。

    暗金色的光芒从手背涌出，顺着篆文的笔画蔓延开来。

    青铜门内传来一连串沉闷的齿轮咬合声，门扇缓缓向内敞开。

    第二重大殿比第一重更大，殿内空空荡荡，只有正中央立着一座高台。

    高台上站着一个“人”。

    不，不是人。

    是一具和活人一模一样的身体——身穿青色道袍，须发皆白，面容清瘦，双眼紧闭。

    他没有呼吸，没有心跳，但皮肤仍有血色，须发仍在微微飘动。

    苏余认得这张脸。

    苏玄。

    他见过两次——一次在矿洞，一次在鬼哭崖水潭。

    他的手指不由自主按在了刀柄上。

    苏玄恶念已被他融合，这具身体里住的是什么东西？

    “时族第八十六代守关人，苏白石。”

    一个低沉的声音从四面八方同时响起，分不清是那具身体发出的还是整座大殿在发声，“奉族长之命，守护时之种九百七十二年又三个月。

    你是继任者？”

    “苏余。”

    他收回了按刀的手。

    那具身体睁开了眼。

    眼眶里没有眼珠，只有两团缓缓旋转的金色漩涡，和苏玄恶念的眼睛如出一辙但又完全不同——苏玄恶念的眼睛是饥饿的，而这两团漩涡是平静的，像两口千年古井。

    “苏玄选中的人。”

    苏白石的声音有了些变化，从那具身体的喉咙里发出，每一个字都带着砂石摩擦的粗粝感，“他选了一个矿奴。”

    苏余没有被这句话刺痛，反而笑了笑：“矿奴命硬。”

    苏白石沉默了片刻，两团金色漩涡微微收缩，像是在审视眼前这个年轻人。

    然后他开口了：“命硬的人，往往命苦。

    你身上已有七道黑痕——两道是苏玄善念传你时王碑时留下的，一道是你自己搏杀时留下的，剩下的，都是恶念给你的。”

    苏余没有说话。

    苏白石继续说了下去：“恶念一辈子都在和天道较劲，到死也没较赢。

    他把复仇之念传给了你，等于是把他的执念刻在了你的命里。”

    “我知道。”

    苏余的语气同样平淡，“他跟我明说了。”

    “知道还接受？”

    “不接受我现在已经死在鬼哭崖了。”

Chapter 14: Surrender the beast wisely and meet the gatekeeper

    The air in the Bronze Hall is as dry as a tomb that has been stored for thousands of years.

    Su Yu stood at the landing point of the teleportation formation, and the cold sweat seeping out of his vest was blown away by the cold wind from nowhere in the palace.

    The aftereffects of three hundred breaths of burning are still there - the bones of his limbs seem to have been removed and stuffed back, and with every step he takes, he can hear the dry friction of his joints.

    He looked around.

    The hall is dozens of feet high, and the dome is covered with dense star maps. The starlight slowly flows along the carvings, like some kind of timekeeping method that has been lost for a long time.

    The walls of the palace are made of a single piece of bronze, and the bronze surface is covered with a layer of dark green patina. Under the patina, the outlines of reliefs can be faintly seen - they are war scenes, with some people wielding swords at the sky, and others being reduced to ashes in the flames.

    All the relief figures have the same expression: looking up to the sky, with angry eyes.

    Su Yu knew what these reliefs were about.

    The memory fragments of Su Xuan's evil thoughts contained the same scene - the destruction of the Time Clan.

    He didn't linger long.

    There is a straight corridor in the center of the hall, leading to the second door.

    There are twelve bronze statues standing on both sides of the corridor, each of them three feet tall, holding a long sword, with the tips of the swords hanging low and crossing over the corridor, forming a cold and cold blade corridor.

    The face of the figure was deliberately chiselled, leaving only a smooth slope, like twelve blurry mirrors.

    Su Yu walked through it.

    The sound of footsteps bounced and echoed in the bronze corridor, changing from one sound to two sounds, and from two sounds to countless sounds.

    He didn't stop or look back.

    People who have stayed in the mines for three years have long since learned to live with the echoes in the darkness.

    At the end of the corridor is the second-level door, which is nine feet high and made of bronze. On the door is engraved a line of ancestral seals of the Shi clan.

    "Only those who hold the King of Time Monument can enter this door."

    Su Yu pressed the seal character "Shi" on the back of his hand against the bronze door.

    Dark golden light gushed out from the back of the hand and spread along the strokes of the seal script.

    A series of dull gear gnashing sounds came from the bronze door, and the door leaf slowly opened inwards.

    The second major hall is larger than the first. The hall is empty except for a high platform standing in the center.

    There is a "person" standing on the high platform.

    No, not people.

    It is a body that is exactly the same as a living person - it is wearing a green Taoist robe, with white beard and hair, a thin face, and closed eyes.

    He was not breathing and had no heartbeat, but his skin was still bloody and his beard and hair were still flowing slightly.

    Su Yu recognized this face.

    Su Xuan.

    He had seen it twice - once in the mine and once in Guiwai Cliff Pool.

    His fingers pressed on the handle of the knife involuntarily.

    Su Xuan's evil thoughts have been fused by him. What is living in this body?

    "The eighty-sixth generation gatekeeper of the Shi clan, Su Baishi."

    A deep voice sounded from all directions at the same time, and it was unclear whether it was coming from that body or from the entire hall, "According to the order of the patriarch, I will guard the Seed of Time for nine hundred and seventy-two and three months.

    Are you the successor? "

    "Su Yu."

    He withdrew the hand holding the knife.

    The body opened its eyes.

    There are no eyeballs in the eye sockets, only two slowly rotating golden whirlpools, which are exactly the same as Su Xuan's evil thoughts but completely different - Su Xuan's evil thoughts' eyes are hungry, but these two whirlpools are calm, like two thousand-year-old ancient wells.

    "The person chosen by Su Xuan."

    Su Baishi's voice had some changes. It came from the throat of that body, and every word had the rough feeling of rubbing sand and stone, "He chose a mining slave."

    Su Yu was not stung by these words, but smiled: "The life of a mine slave is tough."

    Su Baishi was silent for a moment, and the two golden vortexes shrank slightly, as if he was examining the young man in front of him.

    Then he spoke: "People who have a tough life often have a miserable life.

    There are already seven black marks on your body - two were left by Su Xuanshan when he passed you the King's Monument, one was left by you when you were fighting, and the rest were all given to you by evil thoughts. "

    Su Yu said nothing.

    Su Baishi continued: "Evil thoughts have been competing with the way of heaven all their lives, and they never won even until their death.

    He passed on his desire for revenge to you, which is equivalent to etching his obsession into your life. "

    "I know."

    Su Yu's tone was equally calm, "He told me clearly."

    "You know it and you still accept it?"

    "If you don't accept it, I'll be dead on Guwai Cliff now."
title_en: Chapter 14: Surrender the beast wisely and meet the gatekeeper
